plan.summary: Q duzeltmesi: 'template gonderim modeli yanlis' — HSM sablonlu projede test, dun geceki render-text-as-plain yaklasimiyla DUZ METIN modeli gonderiyordu; PR-4 + CxapiSend artik canli oldugundan test GERCEK template wire modelini (template{templateId, parameters[{paramKey,value}], headerMedia}) kullanmali (wapcrm-api-integration-guide §3.2). Ayrica cxapi chatPhoneNumber kontrati '905...' (+'siz) — sender E.164'un basindaki '+'i siler (Q: '+ sorun degil' dedi ama dokuman kontrati net; INMA ikisini de kabul ediyor, kontrata uyuyoruz). Bonus: failed_reason_sample COALESCE(failed_reason, provider_error_message) — cxapi 621/622 reddi artik operatore gorunur.
plan.q_intent: http istegi dokumana uyacak. yanlis gondermissin. [...] + sorun degil. template gonderim modeli yanlis
plan.interview_notes: Onceki 'HSM testi render-metin duz gider' karari (dun gece, PR-4 yokken verilen yaklasiklik) Q tarafindan SUPERSEDED — full test = gercek HSM wire. Param degerleri ornek alicidan cozulur; ornek deger yoksa paramKey gorunur dummy olarak gider (622 reject'ten ogretici). Canli katalog dogrulamasi test yolunda YOK (run-path'in korumasi); cxapi 621/622 donerse provider_error_message UI'da gosterilir — bilincli tasarim.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: HSM sablonlu projede Test Gonder, cxapi'ye GUIDE-uyumlu template wire body gonderir: {instanceID, userID, chatPhoneNumber('+'siz), template:{templateId, parameters[{paramKey,value}], headerMedia?}} — messageType/messageText YOK; duz-metin projede eski plain model aynen.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: TestSendAsync HSM dali BroadcastSendRequest{WaTemplateId, TemplateHeaderMediaUrl, Recipients[0].Variables=params} + overrideInstanceId kurar -> orkestrator HSM uretimi -> MessageSenderService template dali -> SendTemplateAsync TemplatePayload (PR-4 wire, guide ile birebir). ToCxapiPhone '+' siler (her iki kind). Build 0E.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Guvenlik/izolasyon: HSM test instance'i tenant-owned Cloud API olmali (IsCloudApiInstanceOwnedAsync, INV-OB-086 reject); CxapiSend allowlist'i orkestratorde INV-OB-085 ile enforce (gate bypass yok); param sayisi/uzunluk ve media URL http(s) cap'leri typed reject; EXACTLY-ONE icerik kaynagi (text XOR template).
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Gate sirasi: Projects -> BulkSend -> throttle -> phone -> [HSM: instance>0 + ownership + param/media caps] -> CreateBroadcastAsync (icinde CxapiSend/085). Tum reject'ler typed INV-OB-086/085.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: cxapi saglayici reddi (621 sablon-yok / 622 eksik-param vb.) UI test sonucunda gorunur: failed_reason_sample = COALESCE(failed_reason, provider_error_message).
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Subquery COALESCE'li, tenant-scoped, parameterized; UI poll degismedi (ayni alani gosteriyor).

files_changed.change: ProjectTestSendRequest += instance_id/wa_template_id/template_params/template_header_media_url (additive optional; EXACTLY-ONE text XOR template dokumante).

TestSendAsync HSM dali: exactly-one guard + instance ownership (IsCloudApiInstanceOwnedAsync) + param/media caps -> BroadcastSendRequest{WaTemplateId, Variables, TemplateHeaderMediaUrl} + overrideInstanceId; audit log kind=hsm:slug/plain.
ToCxapiPhone: chatPhoneNumber '+'siz (guide §2/§3.2 kontrati) — plain + template her iki callsite.
failed_reason_sample = COALESCE(failed_reason, provider_error_message) — cxapi 621/622 operatore gorunur.
sendTest: HSM'de template_params (ornek alicidan; deger yoksa paramKey dummy) + headerMedia + instance_id ile gercek HSM testi; not metni guncellendi.

build.command: tsc && vite build (Dashboard) + dotnet build InvektoServis.sln --no-restore -v q

verification_questions.question: HSM test yolunda gate sirasi yan-etkiden ONCE tam mi: Projects -> BulkSend -> throttle -> PhoneNormalizer -> instance>0 -> IsCloudApiInstanceOwnedAsync(tenant-scoped, parameterized) -> param/media caps -> CreateBroadcastAsync(icinde CxapiSend allowlist INV-OB-085, HSM bridge-fallback YOK); ownership reddi typed INV-OB-086 mi (sessiz default yok)?

Wire conformance: TestSendAsync'in kurdugu BroadcastSendRequest (WaTemplateId + Recipients[0].Variables + TemplateHeaderMediaUrl + overrideInstanceId) orkestratorun MEVCUT PR-4 HSM uretimine (hsmParamsJson=Serialize(Variables), template_ref/template_params/template_header_media) ve oradan SendTemplateAsync TemplatePayload'una (template{templateId,parameters[{paramKey,value}],headerMedia}, language YOK) degismeden akiyor mu — yeni paralel uretim yolu YOK mu?

EXACTLY-ONE icerik kaynagi: text XOR template guard'i her kombinasyonda typed INV-OB-086 mi (ikisi bos / ikisi dolu); plain yol onceki davranisla bit-identik mi (4096 cap dahil); ToCxapiPhone yalniz bastaki '+'i mi siliyor (E.164 digit'leri bozulmaz, bridge yolu etkilenmez — bridge kendi regex'iyle phone cikarir)?

COALESCE'li failed_reason_sample subquery'si tenant-scoped + parameterized kaldi mi ve yalniz status='failed' mesajlardan mi okuyor (sent/ambiguous karismaz); additive alan tuketicileri etkilemiyor mu?

Lifecycle: HSM test broadcast'i message_kind='wapcrm_template' satiri uretir, MessageSenderService pre-parse/CAS state machine (PR-3a/PR-4) degismeden calisir; canli katalog dogrulamasinin test yolunda OLMAMASI bilincli ve dokumante mi (621/622 provider reddi failed_reason_sample ile UI'a tasinir — sessiz kayip yok)?

non_goals: Test yolunda canli template-katalog dogrulamasi (run-path korumasi; cxapi reddi UI'a tasiniyor)
messageCategory alani (ayri is — Q'ya soruldu, karar bekliyor)
intentional_exclusions: Param degeri yoksa paramKey dummy gider (bos deger 622 uretir; gorunur dummy testi ogretici kilar — UI yorum satirinda dokumante)

try_catch_locations: UI sendTest poll per-iteration catch + dis catch + finally (degismedi)
user_facing_errors: INV-OB-086 varyantlari: kanal secin / kanal hesaba ait degil / parametre gecersiz / medya URL gecersiz / tek icerik kaynagi
